title: Assertion: Strobe Pulse Shape
constraints: Rule 1: every `strobe` pulse is exactly **one** cycle wide.
Rule 2: after a pulse, `strobe` stays low for at least **2** cycles before the next pulse.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: Rule 2: when strobe has just fallen (`$fell(strobe)`), it must also be low one cycle later: `$fell(strobe) |=> !strobe`.
Pulse-shape rules are typical for interrupt lines and one-shot command strobes.
